generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Longer crossover sibling of the 2022 Bolt EV refresh, same 65 kWh pack and about 55 kW DC peak, 11 kW onboard AC standard. Sold 2022-2023 only. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/490154/technical-comparison-new-chevrolet-bolt-ev-euv/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Bolt
